summary: NaaS Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K to report the results of an extraordinary general meeting held on April 29, 2026. Shareholders approved two ordinary resolutions: an amendment to increase authorized share capital from US$52,000 to US$369,200, divided into multiple share classes (Class A, B, C, D and a general pool), and authorization for directors to carry out the amendment. This is a routine capital-structure housekeeping matter with no acquisition, divestiture, or special-situation event. The filing simply confirms shareholder approval of a share-capital increase for future flexibility. No deal terms, premium, or strategic change apply.
